title: Search Filter List
prompt:
You are a web developer. Complete the following task.

TASK: Build a React functional component called `SearchFilter` that takes a prop `items` (array of strings) and renders a search input and a filtered list. As the user types in the search input, the list should filter to show only items that contain the search text case-insensitively. If no items match, show "No results found." Display the count of matching items as "Showing {n} of {total}".

CONSTRAINTS:
- Functional component with `useState`
- Default export
- Props: `items` (string array)
- Case-insensitive filtering
- Show "No results found." when no matches
- Display "Showing {n} of {total}"

IMPORTANT:
- Return ONLY the code. No explanations.
- Output a single complete file.
- Do not use markdown code blocks.
constraints: Show "No results found." when no matches
